content:
WhatsApp users can now share longer music clips in their status updates, with the length limit doubled from before to 30 seconds. The following is a detailed introduction.

WhatsApp status music clip length extended to 30 seconds

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is gradually rolling out support for music clips up to 30 seconds long for use in status updates.

The status update function is similar to Instagram Stories on WhatsApp. Previously, posts containing music were limited to 15 seconds.

Users can now select songs up to 30 seconds long to post together with photos, or use the music clip directly as a status update.

The following is WABetaInfo's explanation of how to select music clip duration under the new 30-second limit:

As is customary for WhatsApp when gradually rolling out new features on the server side, the new 30-second limit has not yet become widespread among all users. However, WABetaInfo points out that some users on both iOS and Android platforms have already seen the new duration limit. On the iOS side, the website specifies that WhatsApp version 26.35.72 is the compatible update.
